answer: A savings account holds money for everyday saving and payments. Nexa supports opening INR savings accounts; balances and full account numbers are available only from your signed-in account records.
hindi: बचत खाता पैसे रखने और रोज़मर्रा के भुगतान के लिए होता है। Nexa में INR बचत खाते खोले जा सकते हैं। आपका बैलेंस और खाता नंबर साइन-इन के बाद खाते के रिकॉर्ड से दिखता है.

answer: A current account is commonly used for frequent payments and receipts. Nexa supports opening INR current accounts. Ask for account details after signing in to see your own account number.

Nexa supports INR savings and current accounts. Open Accounts to open an account, see balances, full account numbers and transaction history. Customer details always come from your authenticated banking records.
hindi: Nexa में INR बचत और चालू खाते उपलब्ध हैं। Accounts में खाता खोलें और बैलेंस, पूरा खाता नंबर और लेनदेन देखें। आपकी जानकारी साइन-इन के बाद बैंकिंग रिकॉर्ड से आती है।
hinglish: Nexa mein INR savings aur current accounts hain. Accounts mein account kholen, balance, poora account number aur transactions dekhein. Aapki details signed-in banking records se aati hain.

answer: A debit card lets you pay using funds associated with a bank account. It is different from a credit card, which uses a borrowing limit.
A credit card lets you borrow within an agreed limit and repay later. Interest, fees and repayment terms depend on the product; Nexa terms must come from verified product information.
An interest rate is a percentage used to calculate the cost of borrowing or the return on savings over a stated period. An annual rate describes a year; it is not your monthly payment.
hindi: ब्याज दर एक प्रतिशत है जिससे उधार की लागत या बचत पर मिलने वाला ब्याज तय अवधि के लिए निकाला जाता है। सालाना दर एक साल की होती है, आपकी मासिक किस्त नहीं।
hinglish: Interest rate ek percentage hai jisse borrowing cost ya savings ka interest calculate hota hai. Annual rate ek saal ki hoti hai, monthly payment nahi.

answer: EMI is a regular loan installment covering principal and interest. Nexa's loan calculator uses the loan amount, annual rate and tenure. Open Loans for an actual quote; the final installment may differ because of rounding.
hindi: EMI लोन की नियमित किस्त है, जिसमें मूलधन और ब्याज शामिल होते हैं। Nexa का कैलकुलेटर लोन राशि, सालाना ब्याज दर और अवधि से किस्त निकालता है। सटीक कोट के लिए Loans खोलें।
hinglish: EMI loan ki regular kist hoti hai, jisme principal aur interest shamil hote hain. Nexa calculator amount, annual rate aur tenure se EMI nikalta hai. Actual quote ke liye Loans kholen.

answer: For monthly installments, EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1), where P is principal, r is the annual percentage rate divided by 1200, and n is months. At zero interest, EMI = P/n. Nexa uses its loan calculation service and rounds to paise; use Loans for your quote.

A loan is money borrowed and repaid under agreed terms. In Nexa, open Loans to calculate a quote, apply with three months of salary slips, track review, accept an approved loan and see disbursement, installments and payments. Approval is not guaranteed.
hindi: लोन उधार लिया गया पैसा है जिसे तय शर्तों पर चुकाना होता है। Nexa में Loans खोलकर कोट, आवेदन, पिछले तीन महीनों की सैलरी स्लिप, समीक्षा, स्वीकृति, भुगतान और किस्तें देख सकते हैं। मंज़ूरी की गारंटी नहीं है।
hinglish: Loan udhaar liya paisa hai jo agreed terms par chukana hota hai. Nexa ke Loans mein quote, application, teen mahino ki salary slips, review, acceptance aur installments milte hain. Approval guaranteed nahi hai.

answer: A personal loan is borrowing for personal needs, repaid under agreed terms. Nexa's supported loan journey includes a quote, application, three months of salary slips, staff review, customer acceptance and internal disbursement.
hindi: पर्सनल लोन निजी ज़रूरतों के लिए लिया गया उधार है। Nexa की लोन प्रक्रिया में कोट, आवेदन, तीन महीनों की सैलरी स्लिप, कर्मचारी समीक्षा और ग्राहक की स्वीकृति के बाद आंतरिक वितरण शामिल है।
hinglish: Personal loan personal zarooraton ke liye udhaar hai. Nexa mein quote, application, teen mahino ki salary slips aur staff review ke baad customer acceptance aur internal disbursement hota hai.

answer: Nexa requires salary slips for the last three months for a loan application. Upload them in Loans. Authorized staff inspect the slips before approving or rejecting the application. Documents do not guarantee approval.
hindi: Nexa में लोन आवेदन के लिए पिछले तीन महीनों की सैलरी स्लिप चाहिए। Loans में उन्हें अपलोड करें। अधिकृत कर्मचारी जाँच के बाद निर्णय लेते हैं।
hinglish: Nexa loan application ke liye pichhle teen mahino ki salary slips chahiye. Loans mein upload karein; authorized staff review ke baad decision lete hain.

answer: Nexa requires salary slips for the last three months for a loan application. Upload them in Loans. Authorized staff inspect the slips before approving or rejecting the application. Documents do not guarantee approval.
hindi: Nexa में लोन आवेदन के लिए पिछले तीन महीनों की सैलरी स्लिप चाहिए। Loans में उन्हें अपलोड करें। अधिकृत कर्मचारी जाँच के बाद निर्णय लेते हैं।
hinglish: Nexa loan application ke liye pichhle teen mahino ki salary slips chahiye. Loans mein upload karein; authorized staff review ke baad decision lete hain.

answer: Nexa requires salary slips for the last three months for a loan application. Upload them in Loans. Authorized staff inspect the slips before approving or rejecting the application. Documents do not guarantee approval.
hindi: Nexa में लोन आवेदन के लिए पिछले तीन महीनों की सैलरी स्लिप चाहिए। Loans में उन्हें अपलोड करें। अधिकृत कर्मचारी जाँच के बाद निर्णय लेते हैं।
hinglish: Nexa loan application ke liye pichhle teen mahino ki salary slips chahiye. Loans mein upload karein; authorized staff review ke baad decision lete hain.

answer: Loan tenure is the length of time planned for repayment. A longer tenure usually lowers each installment but can increase total interest. Use Nexa's loan calculator to compare actual quotes.
Principal is the amount borrowed or still owed before interest and other charges. Each loan installment can include both principal and interest.

Outstanding loan balance is the amount still owed. It may differ from a payoff quote because a payoff calculation follows the loan's applicable settlement rules. Your actual balance must come from your loan record.

A partial prepayment pays some principal early. Nexa compares two options: reduce tenure keeps EMI approximately the same and finishes earlier; reduce EMI lowers the installment while keeping existing due dates. Open your loan's prepayment calculator for a current comparison, then review and explicitly confirm before posting.
hindi: आंशिक पूर्वभुगतान से लोन का कुछ मूलधन जल्दी चुकता होता है। Nexa में अवधि घटाने पर EMI लगभग वही रहती है; EMI घटाने पर मौजूदा देय तिथियाँ रहती हैं। वास्तविक तुलना के लिए अपने लोन का prepayment calculator खोलें।
hinglish: Partial prepayment se kuch principal jaldi chukta hota hai. Reduce tenure mein EMI lagbhag same rehti hai; reduce EMI mein due dates same rehti hain. Apne loan ke calculator mein compare karke review aur confirm karein.

answer: Loan payoff settles the remaining amount required to close a loan. In Nexa, open your loan to request a current payoff preview. Review the amount and explicitly confirm; discussing payoff does not make a payment.
A loan quote shows a calculation based on the amount, rate and tenure. In Nexa, calculate it in Loans before applying. A quote is not loan approval or disbursement.

In Loans, submit an application and the last three months of salary slips. Authorized staff review it. After approval, the customer must accept before internal disbursement. Open your application to see its actual status.
Open Loans and select your loan to view installments, amounts due and payment history. An EMI payment must be reviewed and explicitly confirmed. Loan payments update Nexa's internal banking records.
A payee is someone you want to pay. In Nexa, add a payee through Payees using a verified Nexa account number. Linked payees point to Nexa accounts. A saved payee does not itself transfer money.
hindi: Payee वह व्यक्ति है जिसे आप भुगतान करना चाहते हैं। Nexa में Payees खोलकर सत्यापित Nexa खाता नंबर से payee जोड़ें। Payee सेव करने से पैसा नहीं भेजा जाता।
hinglish: Payee woh hai jise aap paisa bhejna chahte hain. Nexa mein Payees se verified Nexa account number ke saath payee add karein. Payee save karne se transfer nahi hota.

answer: A bank transfer moves money between accounts. Nexa supports transfers between your own accounts and to linked Nexa payees. Enter details, review the saved proposal, explicitly confirm and keep the receipt. Retry protection prevents the same confirmed review from being posted twice. External-bank transfers are demonstrations and do not move external funds.
hindi: बैंक ट्रांसफर से खातों के बीच पैसा जाता है। Nexa में अपने खातों और सत्यापित Nexa payees को ट्रांसफर कर सकते हैं। विवरण भरें, सुरक्षित समीक्षा देखें और स्पष्ट पुष्टि करें। एक ही समीक्षा दोबारा पुष्टि करने से दोबारा भुगतान नहीं होता। बाहरी बैंक ट्रांसफर डेमो हैं और बाहरी पैसा नहीं भेजते।
hinglish: Transfer se accounts ke beech paisa jata hai. Nexa mein apne accounts aur linked Nexa payees ko transfer karein: details, saved review, explicit confirmation aur receipt. Same review ki retry se duplicate payment nahi hota. External-bank transfers demo hain; external funds nahi move hote.

answer: A scheduled payment is planned for a future date or recurring schedule. Nexa shows recorded scheduled payments in Scheduled payments. Availability of creation and automatic execution must be verified in the current product; a listed schedule or a discussion is not proof that money was sent.
hindi: शेड्यूल्ड भुगतान भविष्य की तारीख या बार-बार होने वाले भुगतान की योजना है। Nexa में Scheduled payments पर दर्ज योजनाएँ दिखती हैं। भुगतान बनाने या अपने-आप चलने की सुविधा की पुष्टि नहीं हुई है; सूची में दिखना पैसा भेजे जाने का प्रमाण नहीं है।
hinglish: Scheduled payment future date ya recurring payment ki planning hai. Nexa ke Scheduled payments mein recorded schedules dikhte hain. Creation aur automatic execution verify nahi hua hai; list mein dikhna payment bhejne ka proof nahi hai.

answer: A direct debit authorizes a payee to collect payments under a mandate. Nexa shows mandates in Direct debits and supports a reviewed cancellation demonstration. External direct-debit provider actions are simulated; they do not contact an external provider.

A mandate records permission for payments under specified conditions, such as an amount limit or frequency. View your recorded mandates in Direct debits. External provider actions in Nexa are simulated.

A bill payment settles an amount owed to a provider. In Nexa, choose a recorded bill, review the source and amount, and explicitly confirm. Check the saved result to distinguish an internal banking posting from a simulated request. The workflow does not contact or settle with a real external bill provider.
hindi: बिल भुगतान किसी प्रदाता को देय राशि चुकाने के लिए होता है। Nexa में बिल और स्रोत खाता चुनें, समीक्षा करें और स्पष्ट पुष्टि करें। सेव नतीजे में देखें कि आंतरिक पोस्टिंग हुई है या अनुरोध डेमो था। वास्तविक बाहरी बिल प्रदाता से संपर्क या सेटलमेंट नहीं होता।
hinglish: Bill payment provider ki due amount settle karne ke liye hota hai. Nexa mein bill aur source choose karke review aur confirm karein. Saved result mein dekhein ki internal posting hui hai ya request simulated thi. Real external provider se contact ya settlement nahi hota.

answer: A card payment is a payment made using a card or, in Nexa's card-payment workflow, a payment request toward a credit-card balance. Nexa's card-provider workflow is a simulation: review and confirmation can save a receipt but do not move external funds.

Freezing a card normally temporarily restricts its use; unfreezing restores use, and replacement requests a new card. In Nexa, open Cards, select a card and choose the action, then review and confirm. These card-network changes are demonstrations: the receipt records a simulated outcome, not a real network change.
hindi: कार्ड फ्रीज़ करने से आम तौर पर उसका इस्तेमाल अस्थायी रूप से रुकता है। Nexa में Cards से फ्रीज़, अनफ्रीज़ या रिप्लेसमेंट चुनें, समीक्षा करें और पुष्टि करें। ये डेमो हैं; रसीद वास्तविक कार्ड नेटवर्क में बदलाव नहीं करती।
hinglish: Card freeze normally card ka use temporarily rokta hai. Nexa mein Cards se freeze, unfreeze ya replacement choose karke review aur confirm karein. Ye demos hain; receipt real card network ko change nahi karti.

answer: A transaction is a recorded banking event, such as a payment, transfer or credit. Open Transactions to view your activity. Only authenticated records can establish what happened in your account.
A transaction category groups activity, such as food or shopping, to make spending easier to understand. Actual spending totals must be calculated from your authenticated transaction records.
A bank statement summarizes account activity over a period. Nexa offers transaction history; a separate downloadable statement feature is not verified in this Knowledge Base.

An account balance is the amount recorded in an account. Available balance is what can currently be used after applicable holds or restrictions. Your Nexa balance must be read from authenticated account data; the Knowledge Base does not store it.
hindi: खाता बैलेंस खाते में दर्ज राशि है। उपलब्ध बैलेंस वह राशि है जिसका लागू रोक या शर्तों के बाद उपयोग किया जा सकता है। आपका वास्तविक Nexa बैलेंस साइन-इन के बाद रिकॉर्ड से आएगा; KB में वह सेव नहीं है।
hinglish: Account balance recorded amount hai. Available balance applicable holds ke baad use hone wali amount hai. Aapka actual Nexa balance authenticated records se aayega; KB mein nahi hota.

answer: Salary credit is income paid into an account by an employer. A concept explanation cannot confirm receipt; ask whether your salary arrived so Nexa can check your recorded transactions.

A receipt records the outcome and reference of a payment request. Nexa saves request reviews and receipts in Payments and card details, where they can be viewed after signing in again. A simulation receipt is not proof of external settlement.
hindi: रसीद भुगतान अनुरोध का नतीजा और संदर्भ रखती है। Nexa में Payments और कार्ड विवरण में सेव रसीदें दोबारा साइन-इन करने पर भी मिलती हैं। डेमो रसीद बाहरी भुगतान होने का प्रमाण नहीं है।
hinglish: Receipt request ka result aur reference rakhti hai. Nexa mein Payments aur card details mein saved receipts dobara sign-in karne par bhi milti hain. Demo receipt external settlement ka proof nahi hai.

answer: Spending summaries group recorded outgoing transactions by period or category. Nexa retrieves your authenticated transaction data for personal totals; the Knowledge Base only explains what the figures mean.

Register or sign in to access your Nexa data. Use Profile for supported settings and sign out when finished. An expired session requires signing in again. Never share passwords, PINs, verification codes, authentication tokens or card security codes in chat.
Nexa supports English, Hindi and Hinglish conversations. Ask in the language you prefer; banking terms can be explained simply without a literal translation.
hindi: Nexa में हिंदी, अंग्रेज़ी और Hinglish में बातचीत कर सकते हैं। अपनी पसंद की भाषा में पूछें।
hinglish: Nexa mein English, Hindi aur Hinglish mein baat kar sakte hain. Apni pasand ki language mein poochhein.

answer: Nexa supports speech input and editable suggested messages in English and Hindi. You can select a suggested message, edit it and send it without using the microphone. Sending a message does not bypass payment review or confirmation.
hindi: Nexa में बोलकर और अंग्रेज़ी या हिंदी के सुझाए गए संदेशों से बातचीत कर सकते हैं। सुझाया संदेश चुनकर बदलें और बिना माइक्रोफ़ोन भेजें। इससे भुगतान की समीक्षा और पुष्टि का नियम नहीं बदलता।
hinglish: Nexa mein speech aur English/Hindi suggested messages hain. Suggestion select karke edit aur send karein, microphone zaroori nahi. Payment review aur confirmation phir bhi required hain.

answer: Nexa supports INR accounts, banking records, linked payees and internal transfers, bills, cards, direct debits, scheduled-payment views and loans. You can chat in English, Hindi or Hinglish and use speech or editable suggestions. External payment networks and card-network changes are simulations.

Authorized staff can search customer and system accounts, inspect details, transactions, related accounts, mandates and audit records, rename or change eligible account status, and post controlled deposits or withdrawals. Loan review includes salary-slip inspection and approval or rejection. Use the administrator workspace; all operations require staff authorization and are audited.
